title: hieracium subumbelliforme
intro: Hieracium subumbelliforme, commonly known as Hawkweed, is a plant species within the dandelion-like Asteraceae family. This plant is used in herbal medicine to address various health issues. The health benefits of Hieracium subumbelliforme include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help in soothing wounds, reducing pain, and protecting against cell damage. The therapeutic actions of this plant include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antifungal activities, attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids.
